recap.back_html: 5 to 10 hand-built rows: normal case, duplicate, null, zero total, empty group, boundary.
Write the test, watch it fail, accept the code, watch it pass, break the code on purpose, watch it fail.
If the test still passes, it misses that rule. A quick form of mutation testing.

recap.back_html: 'List every assumption this code makes about its input data, one per line.' Then check each on real data.
Unique keys per grain, non-null positive weights, id formats, UTC timestamps, one lookup row per key.
SQL vs DataFrame code, pandas vs Spark on an extract, gold totals vs silver aggregates. Not the same assistant rewriting itself.
Run both on known-answer data. The one matching the hand-worked answer is right.
